# FDG4025

> DO NOT add members to an interface that has previously shipped.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.6 Interface Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: a versioning rule about interfaces already shipped to external implementers. Not machine-checkable without a baseline of the shipped API.

## From the book

Doing so would break implementations of the interface. You should create a new interface to avoid versioning problems.

Except for the situations described in these guidelines, you should, in general, choose classes rather than interfaces in designing managed code reusable libraries.
